_doc: Owner 2026-11-22: find, per stock x TF, which triggers catch the moves (move_triggers.py). Triggers are EVENTS (first candle the condition becomes true). Generated from the sections below + 'extra' + the strategy library. Exits are structure exits (stop below the last swing low, target an EMA level or N x risk), held until stop/target (overnight on intraday). Labels (recency-weighted, owner's most important rule): HC = high confidence, HCLT = high confidence but low trades, MC = medium, LC = low/avoid.
_labels_note: labels are judged on each trigger's own record first (column 'Trigger alone'); a filtered version is shown only when one of the short-list filters improves it

labels._doc: All need recency-weighted average > 0 and total > 0. HC: >= min_trades and weighted win >= min_win_w. HCLT: min..max trades with at most max_losses losses (0 below small_below trades). MC: weighted win >= min_win_w. Else LC.

HCLT._doc: owner 2026-11-22: HCLT fires in ANY trend - never gated by trend / phase guards or a losing-streak pause; short-list filters are allowed when they improve it

filter._doc: owner 2026-11-22: a filter may only come from this SHORT list of conditions a trader uses (not ~1400 machine conditions - that made 3/3 appear by luck). Per trigger x exit the program tries each and keeps the best only if it improves the label/score. Conditions the data cannot compute are skipped.

conditions.BullPhase: ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50)
conditions.NotBearPhase: not (ema(close, 9) < ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) < ema(close, 50))
conditions.NotBelowFallingHourlyEMA200: not htf(close < ema(close, 200) and ema(close, 200) < ema(close, 200)[10], "60m")

trend_guard._doc: OFF (owner 2026-11-22): blocking all longs below a falling hourly EMA 200 removed 59% of RELIANCE 15m candles incl. the owner's own bottom-reversal setups (EMA13x20 -> target EMA 200). Now offered per trigger as the filter NotBelowFallingHourlyEMA200 instead. Set enabled true to block globally again.

replay._doc: causal, no split date: every refit_sessions of the last months, stand at that moment (closed trades only, recency-weighted), take signals of the top HC/HCLT strategies until the next refit, one position at a time
